metadata.encoding_notes: The published file begins with a UTF-8 byte order mark and uses LF line endings; the first header cell is country. Bytes are stored exactly as published.

indicator_units.Daily ICU occupancy: patients (COVID-19 patients in ICU on a given day)
indicator_units.Daily hospital occupancy: patients (COVID-19 patients in hospital on a given day)
indicator_units.Weekly new ICU admissions per 100k: new admissions of COVID-19 patients per 100 000 population per week
indicator_units.Weekly new hospital admissions per 100k: new admissions of COVID-19 patients per 100 000 population per week

metadata.indicator_units_source: https://www.ecdc.europa.eu/sites/default/files/documents/2021-01-13_Variable_Dictionary_and_Disclaimer_hosp_icu_all_data.pdf, variable table on pp. 1-2 (variable list labelled as of 20200813)
metadata.tenant_note: kalhas-reference is the repository namespace for real public reference data; synthetic Phase 29 artifacts remain under kalhas-synthetic
metadata.time_notes: The dictionary defines date only as 'Date for daily occupancy indicators' and year_week as YYYY-Www; it gives no separate definition of date for weekly rows. time_semantics observation_date follows the dictionary for daily occupancy rows. Daily occupancy rows and weekly admission rows coexist in the same file; in this file every weekly row carries a Sunday date and a year_week, which is a description of the bytes and not a dictionary definition.
metadata.title_note: source.title is the publisher page title as inferred from its URL; the publisher page itself was not fetched in this intake.

revision_notes: ECDC ceased updates on 1 December 2023 (final week 47 of 2023). Corrections after closure are not guaranteed (register entry R30-D01/D01, note U02).
